events.title: Demo Hotfix 1.1 - Truck fix , city growth
events.summary: Demo Hotfix 1.1Thanks to everyone who reported bugs during Next Fest!FixesTrucks no longer swap delivery destinations between stores. Stores in the same city were being reordered every turn, which caused trucks to deliver to the wrong store when you had more than one.BalanceCity growth reworked. Cities now grow more steadily and can no longer grow explosively. Growth is capped per turn, also, in order to grow at maximum speed it needs demand to be met for all products.
